name: Runner Extras - Date Virtual Table Window
brief: Issues #2309, #2648, #3006, #3483 and #3506: the Date system virtual table (2000000007) is computed on demand on the service tier by DateDataProvider, across years 1 through 9999. Since #3506 the runner serves it from that same provider, so no row is materialised. This suite pins the runner-specific remainder: that the 500,000-row cap, the 1900-01-01..2099-12-31 base window and the half-open refusal a materialised store forced are gone from every request path.
description: What the Date table itself answers - which weekday a date is, which ISO week a Monday starts, when a leap February ends, that Period End is a closing date, what an open-ended Period Start range selects - is plain BC behaviour and is covered upstream in the al-language corpus (Test Date Virtual Table, codeunit 60983). This suite deliberately asserts none of it exactly. Each arm asserts a LOWER BOUND past a number the runner used to impose: a count above the old 500,000-row cap, a first row before the window's 1900 edge, a last row past its 2099 edge, a keyed Get eight centuries outside any store. Plus one exact control inside the old window, so no arm can pass against a provider that answers nonsense in the ordinary case.
